ret: 1 training day (A) holding 2 exercises, over block weeks train ×3, deload, repeating.
Block weeks: train, train, train, deload, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed. Loads on a 2.5 kg grid.
Rotation: Each training week: Day A, then Day A.
Attendance (from the rotation): Train at least 2 times in each 7-day window (from your start day). If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.
Reads your diet phase (kept on file); your readiness check-in (checked in before the session; ignored once older than a day).
In deload block weeks: deload each session: 90% of the load, 100% of any timed work, 50% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve, and no intensifier.
When your sessions in a row with a missed set is at least 3: deload each session: 90% of the load, 100% of any timed work, 50% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve, and no intensifier.
When your diet phase (“maintain” if unknown) is “cut”: any decrease in your working loads is proposed for your OK instead of applied, and set counts are not cut.
When your readiness check-in is at most readiness 2 (no if unknown): deload each session: 90% of the load, 100% of any timed work, 100% of the sets, at least 3 in reserve, and no intensifier.
Together (every matching rule applies, in the order listed):
When this is a deload week and your sessions in a row with a missed set is at least 3: the rules stack, so each session is 81% of the load, 25% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.

When this is a deload week and your readiness check-in is at most readiness 2 (no if unknown): the rules stack, so each session is 81% of the load, 50% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.

When your sessions in a row with a missed set is at least 3 and your readiness check-in is at most readiness 2 (no if unknown): the rules stack, so each session is 81% of the load, 50% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.

When this is a deload week and your sessions in a row with a missed set is at least 3 and your readiness check-in is at most readiness 2 (no if unknown): the rules stack, so each session is 72.9% of the load, 25% of the sets, at least 4 in reserve and no intensifier.
press: 2 sets of 8 reps to 12 reps on Flat DB Press, the last set extended rest-pause; add 2 kg once the rest-pause set totals 20 reps.
row: 4 sets of 6 on Chest-Supported Row in clusters of 2 with short rests; add 2.5 kg once every set is done.

After each session (muscle plan): Set sessions in a row with a missed set to (if every working set reached its target: 0; if a working set fell short: your sessions in a row with a missed set plus 1; if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: your sessions in a row with a missed set).

ret: 2 sets of 8 reps to 12 reps on Flat DB Press, the last set extended rest-pause; add 2 kg once the rest-pause set totals 20 reps
Starts with working weight = nothing; written by session, owner.

Plan: Flat DB Press: 2 sets of 8 reps to 12 reps at your working weight; finish with a rest-pause (as many reps as possible (at least 3 reps) resting 15 s, then as many reps as possible (at least 2 reps) resting 15 s).
After each session: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) the earned weight; (2) your working weight; (3) the best load you logged on “work”.

Starts with working weight = nothing; written by session, owner.
Plan: Chest-Supported Row: 4 sets of 6 reps at your working weight in clusters of 2 reps with 20 s between.

After each session: Set working weight to whichever is known first: (1) (if every working set reached its target: your working weight plus 2.5 kg; if a working set fell short: your working weight; if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: your working weight); (2) the best load you logged on “work”.
